proposals.title: Core branded integer types and arithmetic with explicit rounding modes
proposals.why_now: Every other package in the monorepo depends on @ciclo/core for nominal types and arithmetic. Core currently exports only CanonicalEncoder. Nothing in world, domain, or application can be implemented until Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick branded types exist with validating constructors (ADR-003), and the division helper with explicit rounding modes exists (ADR-004 DEFINIR). This is the hard dependency root of the entire FASE-1 critical path and has been unimplemented for multiple consecutive cycles.

proposals.title: Positional RNG and ADR for hash function
proposals.why_now: INV-02 — consulting price(asset,t) directly equals arriving at t tick by tick — is the spec's self-described most important test. It requires a positional RNG. ADR-002 marks the hash function as DEFINIR with a strong recommendation of SplitMix64 over FNV-1a but no decision has been recorded. Without RNG, the price generator, bot policies, macro events, and NPC tips cannot be started. The ADR must be written first because the hash function must be specified bit-by-bit before any implementation exists, since changing it retroactively invalidates all reference StateHash values.

proposals.why_now: The ledger is the source of truth for all economic state (INV-04 through INV-07). It must exist before market orders, the tick loop, or any save/replay work can proceed. The domain package is entirely a stub. The ledger interface is fully specified: Transaction, Entry, Account, per-commodity balance-zero invariant, causationId required on every transaction. It depends only on IDEA-001 and can proceed in parallel with IDEA-002.

proposals.why_now: The spec states explicitly that the installer must exist in FASE-1 in minimal form, not at the end, because multiplataform packaging issues (native module ABI, file paths) discovered late are not correctable at architecture level. proposals.title: Price generator for two assets with two noise layers
proposals.why_now: INV-02 — the spec's most important test — requires price(asset,t) to be consultable positionally. The fractal octave construction (trendLayer + idiosyncraticNoise) is the first substantive use of the positional RNG and fixed-point arithmetic in the world package. Two noise layers and two assets are the minimum for FASE-1 acceptance. Fixed-point implementations of interpolation must be decided by ADR since transcendental functions (Math.sin, Math.exp) are lint-blocked and the approach must produce bit-identical results on Windows and Linux (INV-19).

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo skeleton, TypeScript strict mode, determinism lint (§13), dependency boundary lint (§14.5), and CanonicalEncoder with ADR-009 are complete. All eight packages, four desktop apps, and three tools remain export{} stubs beyond core. Five test suites pass. No domain logic exists: core has only CanonicalEncoder; world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui are empty; all Electron apps are empty; tools/replay and tools/bench have no implementation. Multiple consecutive checkpoints report NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: @ciclo/core lacks the nominal integer types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick) and division helper with explicit rounding modes that every other package depends on. No ADR exists for the hash function (ADR-002 DEFINIR item). Without these two foundational pieces, no work in world, domain, or application can begin.

warnings: ADR-004 requires that calling division without an explicit rounding mode be a compile-time or lint-blocking error — the enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR and must be decided by ADR before core arithmetic is implemented. A lint rule over the bare / operator on branded types is one approach; a typed helper function that requires the mode parameter is another. The decision must precede implementation.

ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation exists. The spec recommends SplitMix64 over FNV-1a but this is a recommendation, not a recorded decision. Changing the hash function after any StateHash reference value exists invalidates all reference values retroactively.

The price generator (§5.1) requires fixed-point implementations of linear interpolation over fractal octaves. Math.sin, Math.cos, Math.exp, Math.log, Math.pow are lint-blocked in pure packages (§13). An ADR must record the fixed-point interpolation approach before world package implementation begins, because the approach determines every price value ever produced and is an INV-19 portability constraint (Windows vs Linux under the same Electron/V8).
